sql_templates.description: Retrieve the latest report run data and diagnostic information for weekly review.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_runs AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM report.enhanced_runs
    WHERE run_ts = (
        SELECT MAX(run_ts)
        FROM report.enhanced_runs
    )
)
SELECT
    er.run_id,
    er.universe_size,
    er.stocks_analyzed,
    er.stocks_filtered,
    er.market_sentiment,
    fs.symbol,
    fs.weekly_signal,
    ss.stage
FROM
    latest_runs er
JOIN
    report.enhanced_filtered_stocks fs ON er.run_id = fs.run_id
JOIN
    scores.stage_snapshots ss ON fs.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE
    ss.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
        FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    )
AND
    ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
LIMIT 50;
